events.details:
Expert Talk Series – 10
In continuation of the Expert Talk Series, The Rewilders has scheduled the next session titled “Wings Over the Aravali”, exploring the fascinating diversity of birds found across the Aravali landscape, their ecological significance, behaviour, habitats, and the importance of bird conservation.
Preeti Anand, a passionate birder and wildlife photographer, will deliver the talk. Preeti has documented close to 1,000 bird species across diverse landscapes of India.
An advocate of urban and backyard birding, she actively contributes to the conservation of green spaces in the Aravali and leads birding walks and other conservation initiatives.
This session will offer insights into the fascinating world of birds and the importance of conserving the green spaces that support their diversity.
Join us for an enriching evening to explore the avian diversity of the Aravali and develop a deeper appreciation for these fascinating winged inhabitants of our landscape.
